summary: Former lookout on Dean State Forest, Lawrence County, OH (US 1582), listed as gone. A 1934 newspaper note names a keeper; no build date or height found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone on the Forest Fire Lookout Association's Ohio list; no source we read describes what remains at the site.

access.note: Dean State Forest is a state forest with published visitor rules; no source we read says whether the former tower site itself is open.

events.note: Chillicothe Gazette note of October 27, 1934 says Frank Weisenberger would take care of the tower on the Dean State Forest
Abandoned Online post titled Pilot Knob Tower, dated May 10, 2023; the text we could read is only the title, date and author line

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and the 1934 Gazette note both name Dean State Forest; the Forest Lookouts header names Wayne National Forest. The story follows the register and says the other name appears.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. No build date, height or removal date found. Staffing rests on one 1934 newspaper note saying Frank Weisenberger would take care of the tower. The May 2023 Abandoned Online post has a readable title but no description; check its photos before changing the gone status. Access is public only in the sense of state-forest visitor rules, not site-specific. Register coordinates (38.692222, -82.634167) differ slightly from the Ohio list (38.69258, -82.63422); the story gives none.
